verdict.rationale: Graphite documents one autonomous background automation: once enabled, Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in selected repositories (docs-19, docs-27, docs-4). Agents can also be given a plain-language task and then pull context, generate changes and open a draft PR on their own (docs-12, docs-52). An 'Automations' feature appears on the pricing page (docs-33), but nothing in the pack explains what it does or how a user configures it. missing for 10: documentation of the Automations feature (user-defined triggers, conditions and actions), evidence of scheduled or event-driven agent runs beyond fixed PR review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
